test.title: Mini-test · The return of the night train

paragraphs.text: For several decades, overnight trains in Europe seemed to be disappearing. Cheap flights and high-speed daytime trains took their passengers, and many national rail companies closed their sleeper services because they lost money. By 2016, a traveller wishing to cross the continent overnight had far fewer choices than in the 1980s.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Since then, the trend has reversed. New routes have opened between major cities, and older services have been restored with modern carriages. Rail operators say demand has been driven largely by travellers who want to reduce the carbon emissions of their journeys, although many passengers also mention the convenience of travelling while they sleep and arriving in a city centre in the morning.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Running a night train is not simple. Sleeping carriages carry fewer passengers than seated ones, so each ticket must be more expensive, and the trains are used only once a day rather than several times. Crossing borders adds further complications, because operators must pay track charges in each country and meet different technical rules.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Prices remain the main obstacle for many travellers. A private cabin can cost more than a flight on the same route, although a place in a shared compartment is often competitive. Some governments have begun to offer subsidies, arguing that the environmental benefits justify public support, while critics reply that the money would do more good if spent on local transport.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Whether the revival lasts will depend on investment in new carriages, which take years to build, and on whether rail companies can agree on shared booking systems. At present, a passenger may need to use several different websites to book a single journey across three countries, a problem that operators have promised to solve.
paragraphs.label: E

document.title: Mini-test · The return of the night train

items.quote: closed their sleeper services because they lost money
items.prompt: Why did many rail companies close their sleeper services?

explanation.en: “closed their sleeper services because they lost money” → A. Old carriages (D) come up later as something replaced in the revival, not as the reason for closure.
explanation.kk: «closed their sleeper services because they lost money» → A. Ескі вагондар (D) кейін жаңғырту кезінде ауыстырылған нәрсе ретінде аталады, жабылу себебі емес.
explanation.ru: «closed their sleeper services because they lost money» → A. Старые вагоны (D) упоминаются позже как то, что заменили при возрождении, а не как причина закрытия.

items.quote: demand has been driven largely by travellers who want to reduce the carbon emissions of their journeys
items.prompt: According to rail operators, demand has grown mainly because travellers

explanation.en: “driven largely by travellers who want to reduce the carbon emissions” → C: “mainly” = “largely”. Prices are actually named as an obstacle (A).
explanation.kk: «driven largely by travellers who want to reduce the carbon emissions» → C: «mainly» = «largely». Баға, керісінше, кедергі ретінде аталады (A).
explanation.ru: «driven largely by travellers who want to reduce the carbon emissions» → C: «mainly» = «largely». Цены, наоборот, названы препятствием (A).

groups.instruction: Questions 1–2. Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.

items.quote: many passengers also mention the convenience of travelling while they sleep and arriving in a city centre in the morning
items.prompt: Which TWO advantages of night trains do passengers mention?

explanation.en: “the convenience of travelling while they sleep and arriving in a city centre” → A and C. B contradicts paragraph D: a private cabin can cost more than a flight.
explanation.kk: «the convenience of travelling while they sleep and arriving in a city centre» → A және C. B — D абзацына қайшы: жеке купе ұшақтан қымбат болуы мүмкін.
explanation.ru: «the convenience of travelling while they sleep and arriving in a city centre» → A и C. B противоречит абзацу D: отдельная каюта бывает дороже самолёта.

items.quote: Sleeping carriages carry fewer passengers than seated ones, so each ticket must be more expensive
items.prompt: Night train tickets have to be expensive partly because

options.text: trains cross several borders an hour.

explanation.en: “carry fewer passengers than seated ones, so each ticket must be more expensive” → B. Borders (A) are a separate difficulty, and “several borders an hour” is a distortion.
explanation.kk: «carry fewer passengers than seated ones, so each ticket must be more expensive» → B. Шекаралар (A) бөлек қиындық ретінде аталған, «several borders an hour» — бұрмалау.
explanation.ru: «carry fewer passengers than seated ones, so each ticket must be more expensive» → B. Границы (A) названы отдельной сложностью, «several borders an hour» — искажение.

groups.instruction: Question 5. Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.

items.quote: operators must pay track charges in each country and meet different technical rules
items.prompt: Which TWO difficulties of running trains across borders are mentioned?

options.text: paying track charges in each country

explanation.en: “pay track charges in each country and meet different technical rules” → A and C. Passport checks (D) come to mind with “borders”, but they are not in the text.
explanation.kk: «pay track charges in each country and meet different technical rules» → A және C. «Borders» сөзін көргенде паспорт тексеру (D) ойға келеді, бірақ мәтінде жоқ.
explanation.ru: «pay track charges in each country and meet different technical rules» → A и C. Паспортный контроль (D) напрашивается при слове «borders», но в тексте его нет.

items.quote: A private cabin can cost more than a flight on the same route
items.prompt: Compared with a flight on the same route, a private cabin

explanation.en: “A private cabin can cost more than a flight on the same route” → B. It is a shared compartment that is often competitive, not a cabin, so A is wrong.
explanation.kk: «A private cabin can cost more than a flight on the same route» → B. Бәсекелес баға — жеке купеде емес, ортақ купедегі орында, сондықтан A қате.
explanation.ru: «A private cabin can cost more than a flight on the same route» → B. Конкурентной бывает цена места в общем купе, а не каюты, поэтому A неверен.

items.quote: critics reply that the money would do more good if spent on local transport
items.prompt: Critics of government subsidies argue that the money

options.text: is too small to make a difference.
should be used to build new carriages.
would be more useful for local transport.

explanation.en: “the money would do more good if spent on local transport” → D. New carriages (C) appear in paragraph E as a condition for success, not as the critics’ view.
explanation.kk: «the money would do more good if spent on local transport» → D. Жаңа вагондар (C) E абзацында сыншылардың пікірі емес, табыстың шарты ретінде аталады.
explanation.ru: «the money would do more good if spent on local transport» → D. Новые вагоны (C) упомянуты в абзаце E как условие успеха, а не как мнение критиков.

items.quote: a passenger may need to use several different websites to book a single journey across three countries, a problem that operators have promised to solve
items.prompt: What problem have operators promised to solve?

options.text: having to use several websites for one journey

explanation.en: “several different websites to book a single journey … a problem that operators have promised to solve” → A. The shortage of carriages (B) matters for success, but operators have not promised to solve it.
explanation.kk: «several different websites to book a single journey … a problem that operators have promised to solve» → A. Вагон тапшылығы (B) — табыстың шарты, бірақ оны шешуге операторлар уәде бермеген.
explanation.ru: «several different websites to book a single journey … a problem that operators have promised to solve» → A. Нехватка вагонов (B) — условие, от которого зависит успех, но решить её операторы не обещали.
